title: Mrs. Helm's dress and cloak in folds on the Fort Dearborn monument
items: On the Fort Dearborn monument (18th Street, 1904), Margaret Helm's skirt is no longer a smooth cone: it falls from her waist in long folds over the knee she sinks on and spreads on the rock, as the c. 1900 photograph shows it.
An overskirt is caught up over her left hip, its hem slanting down across the front, and her cloak hangs off her right forearm in a heavy fold gathered at its foot.
